interpretation_limits: Models differ between these two runs; do not infer that scheduling alone caused the behavioral difference.
The coarse current_url_missing flag also matches a normal host_conversation object and does not establish URL injection failure.
Generic HTTP_SEND_CANDIDATE_NOT_PROVEN classifications before publication may be article fetches, not Work sends.
No hidden model reasoning, provider credentials or webhook addresses are required to diagnose these records.
A runtime success status is not evidence of completed report delivery.
